name: Hotel Gasthof Neuner
beschreibung: The Hotel Gasthof Neuner is a traditional house in the town of Imst. It is located in the Oberinntal and is surrounded by the mountain landscape of the Lechtaler Alpen. The dining areas and rooms are kept in Tiroler style. Nearby are the Hoch-Imst ski area as well as numerous hiking trails for the summer. The amenities include a restaurant with regional cuisine and parking spaces for guests. Guests can expect accommodation with personal service here. The quiet atmosphere allows relaxation after activities in nature.
